name: 01_library
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate a NEW original comic image, using attached contact sheets only as visual style references, never as character identity references. Do not recreate any existing character, costume, logo, dialogue, page title or reference-sheet labels. All people are new ordinary human adults with round human ears, no animal ears, no horns, no halos, no tactical uniforms. Visual grammar: compact 2 to 2.6 heads tall chibi bodies (head excludes hair accessories), large wide rounded head, shallow flat rounded chin, tiny neck, low-set big simple oval eyes or half-lidded eyes, heavy upper eyelid, flat iris with at most one small white spot, tiny line mouth and usually no nose. Hair is 4 to 7 large silhouette clumps, one flat base color, one hard edged shadow shape, one or two broad oval flat highlight spots, no fine strands. Short mitten hands, short block feet, two or three clothing structure lines. Confident near-black contour, outer lines heavier than interior lines. Flat solid colors, only one hard edged cel shadow per material, no painterly texture, no soft volume on faces, no cinematic lighting. Pale cyan or cream environment lines much lighter than people; dotted halftone only in selected background areas. Black rectangular comic border, clear expressive silhouette, ample room for short white speech balloons. Match the visual simplification of the references, not glossy generic anime or 3D toys. Render only the requested scene, no reference board or style notes.
Scene request: Single landscape comic panel. A new librarian with dark auburn square bob, green cardigan and tan skirt stands fully visible on both feet carrying three books; she notices a bookmark stuck on her shoe. One raised mitten hand, mild puzzled half-lidded expression. Sparse library shelves and floor line. One small white speech balloon, exact Chinese text: "咦？". Test full-body proportions and clothing simplification.
